meta.title: FreeRoute
meta.description: Aggregate free-tier and custom model upstreams with transparent failover and key rotation

en.autoTakeoverTitle: Auto takeover: switch the default model to {route}/auto once a free upstream is usable (see each provider for key guides)
en.catHint1: One provider per line in the catalog JSON (fields below):
en.catHint2: · apikey optional: full key ring imported on sync and joins rotation
en.catHint3: · freeModels optional: declare the free list when model ids lack a "free" marker
en.catHint4: · proxy optional: set when this upstream needs a proxy
en.catHint5: Model lists are probed after sync — also accepts models.dev api.json.
en.copyHint: Copy this file to migrate/replace · edits apply in ~5s · optional "keys" field imports secrets once (fills empty slots only)
en.hideUpstreamTitle: Hide this upstream from the list (remote sync will not resurrect it; restore below)
en.modelsMissing: Built-in models settings component not found (dsh version incompatible?). Use the "Free" tab to configure free models.
en.phConfigured: Type to replace the configured keys; separate multiples with newlines/commas
en.phEmpty: Paste your {name} API key (multiples separated by newlines/commas — auto rotation)
en.proxyHint1: · Applies to every upstream without its own proxy (chat + model probing)
en.proxyHint2: · Per-upstream / catalog proxy wins over global; catalog sync is always direct
en.stateBad: Unexpected state shape (host/client version mismatch — restart dsh web and reload)
en.takenOverTitle: Default model switched to {route}/auto automatically in this process
